name: What is included in a multi-room painting estimate?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a multi-room painting estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: A comprehensive multi-room painting estimate from City Dweller, LLC will typically include a detailed breakdown of costs for labor, materials (paint, primer, tape, drop cloths, etc.), and preparation work (patching, sanding, minor repairs). It should also specify the number of coats, the types of paint and finishes to be used, and a projected timeline for completion. Any additional services, such as wallpaper removal or extensive repairs, will be itemized separately. We aim for transparency, ensuring you understand every aspect of the investment for your Burlingame or Foster City property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Estimates include costs for labor, materials, and prep work, specifying coats, paint types, finishes, and project timeline. Additional services are itemized separately.
